import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Main

/-!
# Renaming of identities: core definitions

Foundation of the renaming bisimulation of the access kernel for
`specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` §49, last paragraph: renamings of place and
authority identities (`Ren`), the relation they induce on places, authorities, pinning
obligations (§74, §75) and states (§38), the order facts carried along runs (`Down`, `SibMono`),
the renamed contract (§48, §80), the renamed operations (§60–§75), and the relation of outcomes
(§58). Generic lemmas on these relations, closed by symmetry.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

namespace Rename

/-! ## Renamings (§49, last paragraph) -/

/-- A renaming of identities (§49, last paragraph): a bijection of `Nat` with its inverse. -/
structure Ren where
  f : Nat → Nat
  g : Nat → Nat
  gf : ∀ i, g (f i) = i
  fg : ∀ i, f (g i) = i

/-- The identity renaming (§49, last paragraph). -/
def Ren.id : Ren := ⟨fun i => i, fun i => i, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl⟩

/-- The inverse renaming (§49, last paragraph). -/
def Ren.symm (π : Ren) : Ren := ⟨π.g, π.f, π.fg, π.gf⟩

/-- Composition of renamings, `π` first (§49, last paragraph). -/
def Ren.comp (π' π : Ren) : Ren :=
  ⟨fun i => π'.f (π.f i), fun i => π.g (π'.g i), fun i => by simp [π'.gf, π.gf],
   fun i => by simp [π'.fg, π.fg]⟩

/-- Renaming of a permutation `τ` of `List.range n` (§49, last paragraph): old `x < n` goes to its
position in `τ`, new `i < n` comes from `τ[i]`; identity from `n` on. -/
def Ren.ofPerm (τ : List Nat) (n : Nat) (h : τ.Perm (List.range n)) : Ren where
  f x := if x < n then τ.idxOf x else x
  g i := if hi : i < τ.length then τ[i] else i
  gf x := by
    have hl : τ.length = n := by simpa using h.length_eq
    by_cases hx : x < n
    · have hm : x ∈ τ := h.mem_iff.2 (List.mem_range.2 hx)
      have hi := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem hm
      simp [hx, hi, List.getElem_idxOf hi]
    · simp [hx, hl]
  fg i := by
    have hl : τ.length = n := by simpa using h.length_eq
    have hnd : τ.Nodup := h.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range
    by_cases hi : i < τ.length
    · have hlt : τ[i] < n := List.mem_range.1 (h.mem_iff.1 (List.getElem_mem hi))
      simp only [hi, dite_true, hlt, ite_true]
      exact (List.Nodup.getElem_inj hnd).1
        (List.getElem_idxOf (List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem (List.getElem_mem hi)))
    · simp [hi, hl ▸ hi]

/-- The inverse of `π` maps forward by `π.g` (§49, last paragraph). -/
@[simp] theorem Ren.symm_f (π : Ren) (i : Nat) : π.symm.f i = π.g i := rfl

/-- The inverse of `π` maps backward by `π.f` (§49, last paragraph). -/
@[simp] theorem Ren.symm_g (π : Ren) (i : Nat) : π.symm.g i = π.f i := rfl

/-- The inverse of the inverse is the renaming (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.symm_symm (π : Ren) : π.symm.symm = π := rfl

/-- A renaming is injective (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.f_inj (π : Ren) {i j : Nat} : π.f i = π.f j ↔ i = j :=
  ⟨fun h => by rw [← π.gf i, h, π.gf], fun h => h ▸ rfl⟩

/-- A renaming is determined by its forward map (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.ext {π π' : Ren} (h : ∀ i, π.f i = π'.f i) : π = π' := by
  have hg : ∀ i, π.g i = π'.g i := fun i => by rw [← π'.fg i, ← h, π.gf]
  obtain ⟨f, g, _, _⟩ := π
  obtain ⟨f', g', _, _⟩ := π'
  simp only [Ren.mk.injEq]
  exact ⟨funext h, funext hg⟩

/-- A renaming composed with its inverse is the identity (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.symm_comp (π : Ren) : π.symm.comp π = Ren.id := Ren.ext fun i => π.gf i

/-- Mapping by `π.f` then `π.g` is the identity on lists (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.map_gf (π : Ren) (l : List Nat) : (l.map π.f).map π.g = l := by
  simp [List.map_map, Function.comp_def, π.gf]

/-- Mapping by `π.g` then `π.f` is the identity on lists (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.map_fg (π : Ren) (l : List Nat) : (l.map π.g).map π.f = l := by
  simp [List.map_map, Function.comp_def, π.fg]

/-- Membership in a renamed list, read backward (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.mem_map (π : Ren) (l : List Nat) (y : Nat) : y ∈ l.map π.f ↔ π.g y ∈ l := by
  rw [← π.map_gf l, List.map_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩; simpa [π.gf] using hx
  · intro hy; exact ⟨π.g y, by simpa [π.gf] using hy, π.fg y⟩

/-- Membership of a renamed identity in a renamed list (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.mem_map_f (π : Ren) (l : List Nat) (x : Nat) : π.f x ∈ l.map π.f ↔ x ∈ l := by
  rw [π.mem_map, π.gf]

/-- The f-form of a membership correspondence gives its g-form (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.mem_iff_g (π : Ren) {L L' : List Nat} (h : ∀ x, π.f x ∈ L' ↔ x ∈ L) (y : Nat) :
    y ∈ L' ↔ π.g y ∈ L := by rw [← h, π.fg]

/-- Universal quantification over all identities, renamed (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.forall_iff (π : Ren) {Q Q' : Nat → Prop} (hQ : ∀ x, Q' (π.f x) ↔ Q x) :
    (∀ y, Q' y) ↔ ∀ x, Q x :=
  ⟨fun h x => (hQ x).1 (h _), fun h y => by rw [← π.fg y]; exact (hQ _).2 (h _)⟩

/-- Universal quantification over corresponding lists (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.forall_mem_iff (π : Ren) {L L' : List Nat} (hL : ∀ x, π.f x ∈ L' ↔ x ∈ L)
    {Q Q' : Nat → Prop} (hQ : ∀ x, Q' (π.f x) ↔ Q x) :
    (∀ y ∈ L', Q' y) ↔ ∀ x ∈ L, Q x :=
  ⟨fun h x hx => (hQ x).1 (h _ ((hL x).2 hx)),
   fun h y hy => by
    rw [← π.fg y] at hy ⊢; exact (hQ _).2 (h _ ((hL _).1 hy))⟩

/-- Existential quantification over corresponding lists (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.exists_mem_iff (π : Ren) {L L' : List Nat} (hL : ∀ x, π.f x ∈ L' ↔ x ∈ L)
    {Q Q' : Nat → Prop} (hQ : ∀ x, Q' (π.f x) ↔ Q x) :
    (∃ y ∈ L', Q' y) ↔ ∃ x ∈ L, Q x :=
  ⟨fun ⟨y, hy, hq⟩ => by
    rw [← π.fg y] at hy hq; exact ⟨_, (hL _).1 hy, (hQ _).1 hq⟩,
   fun ⟨x, hx, hq⟩ => ⟨_, (hL x).2 hx, (hQ x).2 hq⟩⟩

/-- Duplicate-free lists with corresponding members are permutations up to renaming (§42: sets
represented by lists; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.perm_of_mem (π : Ren) {L L' : List Nat} (hnd : L.Nodup) (hnd' : L'.Nodup)
    (h : ∀ x, π.f x ∈ L' ↔ x ∈ L) : L'.Perm (L.map π.f) := by
  have hm : (L.map π.f).Nodup :=
    List.pairwise_map.2 (hnd.imp fun hab e => hab ((Ren.f_inj π).1 e))
  refine (List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup hnd' hm).2 fun y => ?_
  rw [π.mem_iff_g h, π.mem_map]

/-! ## Generic list and option lemmas -/

/-- A duplicate-free list of `n` identities below `n` is a permutation of `List.range n` (§49,
last paragraph). -/
theorem perm_range_of_nodup {l : List Nat} {n : Nat} (hnd : l.Nodup) (hlt : ∀ a ∈ l, a < n)
    (hlen : l.length = n) : l.Perm (List.range n) := by
  refine (List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup hnd List.nodup_range).2 fun a =>
    ⟨fun ha => List.mem_range.2 (hlt a ha), fun ha => ?_⟩
  refine Classical.byContradiction fun hna => ?_
  have hsub : l ⊆ (List.range n).erase a := fun b hb =>
    (List.mem_erase_of_ne (fun e => hna (by subst e; exact hb))).2 (List.mem_range.2 (hlt b hb))
  have := List.Nodup.length_le_of_subset hnd hsub
  rw [List.length_erase_of_mem ha, List.length_range] at this
  have : 0 < n := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) (List.mem_range.1 ha)
  omega

/-- `flatMap` of pointwise permutations is a permutation (§44: `D(p)` is a set; §49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem perm_flatMap_pointwise {α β : Type} {f g : α → List β} :
    ∀ {l : List α}, (∀ a ∈ l, (f a).Perm (g a)) → (l.flatMap f).Perm (l.flatMap g)
  | [], _ => .nil
  | a :: l, h => by
    simp only [List.flatMap_cons]
    exact (h a (List.mem_cons_self ..)).append
      (perm_flatMap_pointwise fun b hb => h b (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hb))

/-- Positions are kept by an injective map (§63.2; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem posIn_map {f : Nat → Nat} (hf : ∀ i j, f i = f j → i = j) (r : Nat) :
    ∀ l : List Nat, posIn (f r) (l.map f) = posIn r l
  | [] => rfl
  | a :: l => by
    simp only [List.map_cons, posIn, posIn_map hf r l]
    by_cases h : a = r
    · subst h; simp
    · have : f a ≠ f r := fun e => h (hf _ _ e)
      simp [h, this]

/-- Two strictly sorted lists with the same members are equal (§63.2: children in index order;
§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem eq_of_sorted_mem {l l' : List Nat} (h : l.Pairwise (· < ·)) (h' : l'.Pairwise (· < ·))
    (hm : ∀ a, a ∈ l ↔ a ∈ l') : l = l' :=
  List.Perm.eq_of_pairwise (le := (· < ·))
    (fun a b _ _ hab hba => absurd (Nat.lt_trans hab hba) (Nat.lt_irrefl _)) h h'
    ((List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup (h.imp Nat.ne_of_lt) (h'.imp Nat.ne_of_lt)).2 hm)

/-- A related `some` has a related `some` (§38: components read by index; §49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem optionRel_some {α β : Type} {r : α → β → Prop} {o : Option α} {o' : Option β} {a : α}
    (h : Option.Rel r o o') (ha : o = some a) : ∃ b, o' = some b ∧ r a b := by
  subst ha; cases h with | some h => exact ⟨_, rfl, h⟩

/-- A related `some`, read backward (§38; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem optionRel_some' {α β : Type} {r : α → β → Prop} {o : Option α} {o' : Option β} {b : β}
    (h : Option.Rel r o o') (hb : o' = some b) : ∃ a, o = some a ∧ r a b := by
  subst hb; cases h with | some h => exact ⟨_, rfl, h⟩

/-- Related options are `none` together (§38; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem optionRel_none_iff {α β : Type} {r : α → β → Prop} {o : Option α} {o' : Option β}
    (h : Option.Rel r o o') : o = none ↔ o' = none := by
  cases h <;> simp

/-- Symmetry of `Option.Rel` (§38; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem optionRel_symm {α β : Type} {r : α → β → Prop} {r' : β → α → Prop}
    (hr : ∀ a b, r a b → r' b a) : ∀ {o o'}, Option.Rel r o o' → Option.Rel r' o' o
  | _, _, .some h => .some (hr _ _ h)
  | _, _, .none => .none

/-- Transitivity of `Option.Rel` (§38; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem optionRel_trans {α β γ : Type} {r : α → β → Prop} {r' : β → γ → Prop}
    {r'' : α → γ → Prop} (hr : ∀ a b c, r a b → r' b c → r'' a c) :
    ∀ {o o' o''}, Option.Rel r o o' → Option.Rel r' o' o'' → Option.Rel r'' o o''
  | _, _, _, .some h, .some h' => .some (hr _ _ _ h h')
  | _, _, _, .none, .none => .none

end Rename

open Rename

/-! ## Renamed holders and places (§40, §42) -/

/-- A holder renamed (§40, §42; §49, last paragraph): frames are not renamed. -/
def Holder.ren (π : Ren) : Holder → Holder
  | .frame f => .frame f
  | .place p => .place (π.f p)

/-- A place renamed (§40; §49, last paragraph): parent and owner renamed, `kind` kept. -/
def Place.ren (π : Ren) (pl : Place) : Place := ⟨pl.parent.map π.f, pl.owner.ren π, pl.kind⟩

namespace Rename

/-- Renaming a holder back (§40, §42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Holder.ren_symm (π : Ren) (h : Holder) : (h.ren π).ren π.symm = h := by
  cases h <;> simp [Holder.ren, π.gf]

/-- Renaming holders is injective (§40, §42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Holder.ren_inj (π : Ren) {a b : Holder} : a.ren π = b.ren π ↔ a = b :=
  ⟨fun h => by rw [← Holder.ren_symm π a, h, Holder.ren_symm], fun h => h ▸ rfl⟩

/-- Renaming holders twice is renaming by the composition (§40, §42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Holder.ren_comp (π π' : Ren) (h : Holder) : (h.ren π).ren π' = h.ren (π'.comp π) := by
  cases h <;> rfl

/-- A renamed holder is a place exactly when the holder is (§70.1; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Holder.isPlace_ren (π : Ren) (h : Holder) : (h.ren π).isPlace = h.isPlace := by
  cases h <;> rfl

/-- Renaming a place back (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Place.ren_symm (π : Ren) (pl : Place) : (pl.ren π).ren π.symm = pl := by
  obtain ⟨p, o, k⟩ := pl
  simp only [Place.ren, Holder.ren_symm, Option.map_map]
  cases p <;> simp [π.gf]

/-- Renaming places twice is renaming by the composition (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Place.ren_comp (π π' : Ren) (pl : Place) : (pl.ren π).ren π' = pl.ren (π'.comp π) := by
  obtain ⟨p, o, k⟩ := pl
  simp only [Place.ren, Holder.ren_comp, Option.map_map]
  rfl

/-! ## Related authorities, obligations, places and states (§38, §40, §42, §74, §75) -/

/-- Authorities related by the renaming (§42; §49, last paragraph); footprints up to permutation
(§42: a set). -/
structure AuthRel (π α : Ren) (y y' : Authority) : Prop where
  mode : y'.mode = y.mode
  origin : y'.origin = y.origin.map α.f
  footprint : y'.footprint.Perm (y.footprint.map π.f)
  holder : y'.holder = y.holder.ren π
  active : y'.active = y.active

/-- Pinning obligations related by the renaming (§74, §75; §49, last paragraph); identities
kept, leaves up to permutation. -/
structure PinRel (π : Ren) (ob ob' : PinOb) : Prop where
  place : ob'.place = π.f ob.place
  leaves : ob'.leaves.Perm (ob.leaves.map π.f)
  active : ob'.active = ob.active

/-- Place lists related by the renaming (§40; §49, last paragraph); fresh identities fixed. -/
structure PRel (π : Ren) (P P' : List Place) : Prop where
  len : P'.length = P.length
  get : ∀ q, P'[π.f q]? = (P[q]?).map (Place.ren π)
  fix : ∀ q, P.length ≤ q → π.f q = q

/-- States related by place renaming `π` and authority renaming `α` (§38; §49, last paragraph);
footprints, anchors (§44: a set) and pinned leaves up to permutation. -/
structure SRel (π α : Ren) (s s' : S3) : Prop where
  F : s'.F = s.F
  nF : s'.nF = s.nF
  P : PRel π s.P s'.P
  I : ∀ l, s'.I (π.f l) = s.I l
  Alen : s'.A.length = s.A.length
  A : ∀ x, Option.Rel (AuthRel π α) (s.A[x]?) (s'.A[α.f x]?)
  Afix : ∀ x, s.A.length ≤ x → α.f x = x
  D : ∀ q, (s'.D (π.f q)).Perm ((s.D q).map α.f)
  dead : ∀ q, s'.dead (π.f q) = s.dead q
  pins : ∀ o : Nat, Option.Rel (PinRel π) (s.pins[o]?) (s'.pins[o]?)

/-- Parent links go to smaller identities (§49.2; representation of acyclicity, §49 last
paragraph). -/
def DownP (P : List Place) : Prop := ∀ j o, parentOf P j = some o → o < j

/-- Origin links go to smaller identities (§49.5; representation of acyclicity, §49 last
paragraph). -/
def DownA (s : S3) : Prop := ∀ j o, s.org j = some o → o < j

/-- Parent and origin links go to smaller identities (§49.2, §49.5; §49, last paragraph). -/
def Down (s : S3) : Prop := DownP s.P ∧ DownA s

/-- `π` keeps the order of the parts of every place, their positional field order (§63.2; §49,
last paragraph). -/
def SibMono (π : Ren) (P : List Place) : Prop :=
  ∀ x y p, parentOf P x = some p → parentOf P y = some p → x < y → π.f x < π.f y

/-- The simulation invariant (§49, last paragraph; §57): related states, both with downward
links, and `π` keeping field order (§63.2). -/
structure Sim (π α : Ren) (s s' : S3) : Prop where
  rel : SRel π α s s'
  down : Down s
  down' : Down s'
  sib : SibMono π s.P

/-- Owner-accepted hypothesis of 2026-11-06 on `Satisfiable` (§71, §48; §49, last paragraph): it
does not distinguish states equal up to permutation of footprint, anchor and pin-leaf lists
(§42, §44). -/
def KExt (k : K) : Prop :=
  ∀ p sh s t, SRel Ren.id Ren.id s t → k.Satisfiable p sh s → k.Satisfiable p sh t

end Rename

/-! ## Renamed contract and operations (§48, §60–§75, §80) -/

/-- The contract renamed (§48, §80; §49, last paragraph). `FreeCompat`'s `auth` is opaque
(§70.2); obligations keep their identities (§75); `Satisfiable` (§71) is read on related
states. -/
def K.rename (π α : Ren) (k : K) : K where
  DeclaredDisjoint r r' := k.DeclaredDisjoint (r.map π.g) (r'.map π.g)
  SharedMutable l := k.SharedMutable (π.g l)
  Pinned l := k.Pinned (π.g l)
  ExternalDone o := k.ExternalDone o
  Deallocable p := k.Deallocable (π.g p)
  FreeCompat p a := k.FreeCompat (π.g p) a
  Satisfiable p sh t := ∃ t₀, SRel π α t₀ t ∧ k.Satisfiable (π.g p) sh t₀

/-- Arguments renamed (§60–§75; §49, last paragraph). Shapes are not renamed (§71.1, §72.2:
fresh parents); `auth` is opaque (§70.2); `o` is an obligation identity (§75). -/
def KernelOp.ren (π α : Ren) : KernelOp → KernelOp
  | .derive src region m => .derive (α.f src) (region.map π.f) m
  | .split src rs => .split (α.f src) (rs.map (·.map π.f))
  | .release a => .release (α.f a)
  | .transfer src dst => .transfer (π.f src) (π.f dst)
  | .depend q x => .depend (π.f q) (α.f x)
  | .enter ps ls => .enter (ps.map α.f) ls
  | .exit => .exit
  | .read a ls => .read (α.f a) (ls.map π.f)
  | .write a ls => .write (α.f a) (ls.map π.f)
  | .writeShared a ls => .writeShared (α.f a) (ls.map π.f)
  | .pin p => .pin (π.f p)
  | .unpin o => .unpin o
  | .endUse p => .endUse (π.f p)
  | .free p auth => .free (π.f p) auth
  | .alloc pr ow ls => .alloc (π.f pr) (π.f ow) ls
  | .store a p => .store (α.f a) (π.f p)

namespace Rename

/-- Contracts corresponding under the renaming, `Satisfiable` excepted (§48, §80; §49, last
paragraph). -/
structure KCorr (π α : Ren) (k k' : K) : Prop where
  dd : ∀ r r', k'.DeclaredDisjoint (r.map π.f) (r'.map π.f) ↔ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r'
  shared : ∀ l, k'.SharedMutable (π.f l) ↔ k.SharedMutable l
  pinned : ∀ l, k'.Pinned (π.f l) ↔ k.Pinned l
  done : ∀ o, k'.ExternalDone o ↔ k.ExternalDone o
  dealloc : ∀ p, k'.Deallocable (π.f p) ↔ k.Deallocable p
  compat : ∀ p a, k'.FreeCompat (π.f p) a ↔ k.FreeCompat p a

/-- Outcomes related by the renaming (§58; §49, last paragraph). -/
def OutRel (π α : Ren) : Outcome3 S3 → Outcome3 S3 → Prop
  | .ok t, .ok t' => SRel π α t t'
  | .reject, .reject => True
  | .fail, .fail => True
  | _, _ => False

/-- Outcome relations corresponding in both directions (§58; §49, last paragraph). -/
def StepCorr (π α : Ren) (R R' : Outcome3 S3 → Prop) : Prop :=
  (∀ o, R o → ∃ o', R' o' ∧ OutRel π α o o') ∧ ∀ o', R' o' → ∃ o, R o ∧ OutRel π α o o'

/-! ## Generic lemmas on the relations (§49, last paragraph) -/

section
variable {π π' α α' : Ren} {s s' s'' : S3} {P P' P'' : List Place}

/-- Related place lists have related bounds (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem PRel.lt_iff (hP : PRel π P P') (q : Nat) : π.f q < P'.length ↔ q < P.length := by
  have := hP.get q
  constructor
  · intro hq
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hq] at this
    cases e : P[q]? with
    | none => rw [e] at this; cases this
    | some _ => exact (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 e).1
  · intro hq
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hq] at this
    cases e : P'[π.f q]? with
    | none => rw [e] at this; cases this
    | some _ => exact (List.getElem?_eq_some_iff.1 e).1

/-- Membership in the place range, renamed (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem PRel.mem_range (hP : PRel π P P') (q : Nat) :
    π.f q ∈ List.range P'.length ↔ q ∈ List.range P.length := by
  simp only [List.mem_range, hP.lt_iff]

/-- Universal quantification over the places, renamed (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem PRel.forall_range (hP : PRel π P P') {Q : Nat → Prop} :
    (∀ y ∈ List.range P'.length, Q y) ↔ ∀ x ∈ List.range P.length, Q (π.f x) :=
  π.forall_mem_iff hP.mem_range fun _ => Iff.rfl

/-- Existential quantification over the places, renamed (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem PRel.exists_range (hP : PRel π P P') {Q : Nat → Prop} :
    (∃ y ∈ List.range P'.length, Q y) ↔ ∃ x ∈ List.range P.length, Q (π.f x) :=
  π.exists_mem_iff hP.mem_range fun _ => Iff.rfl

/-- Symmetry of related place lists (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem PRel.symm (hP : PRel π P P') : PRel π.symm P' P where
  len := hP.len.symm
  get q := by
    have := hP.get (π.g q)
    rw [π.fg] at this
    rw [Ren.symm_f, this, Option.map_map]
    cases P[π.g q]? <;> simp [Function.comp_def, Place.ren_symm]
  fix q hq := by
    have := hP.fix q (hP.len ▸ hq)
    show π.g q = q
    conv => lhs; rw [← this]
    exact π.gf q

/-- Transitivity of related place lists (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem PRel.trans (hP : PRel π P P') (hP' : PRel π' P' P'') : PRel (π'.comp π) P P'' where
  len := hP'.len.trans hP.len
  get q := by
    show P''[π'.f (π.f q)]? = _
    rw [hP'.get, hP.get, Option.map_map]
    congr 1; funext pl; exact Place.ren_comp π π' pl
  fix q hq := by
    show π'.f (π.f q) = q
    rw [hP.fix q hq, hP'.fix q (hP.len ▸ hq)]

/-- Authorities related: footprint membership (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem AuthRel.mem_footprint {y y' : Authority} (hr : AuthRel π α y y') (l : Nat) :
    π.f l ∈ y'.footprint ↔ l ∈ y.footprint :=
  hr.footprint.mem_iff.trans (π.mem_map_f _ _)

/-- Symmetry of related authorities (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem AuthRel.symm {y y' : Authority} (h : AuthRel π α y y') : AuthRel π.symm α.symm y' y where
  mode := h.mode.symm
  origin := by rw [h.origin, Option.map_map]; cases y.origin <;> simp [α.gf]
  footprint := by
    have := h.footprint.map π.g
    rw [Ren.map_gf] at this; exact this.symm
  holder := by rw [h.holder, Holder.ren_symm]
  active := h.active.symm

/-- Transitivity of related authorities (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem AuthRel.trans {y y' y'' : Authority} (h : AuthRel π α y y') (h' : AuthRel π' α' y' y'') :
    AuthRel (π'.comp π) (α'.comp α) y y'' where
  mode := h'.mode.trans h.mode
  origin := by rw [h'.origin, h.origin, Option.map_map]; rfl
  footprint := h'.footprint.trans ((h.footprint.map π'.f).trans (by rw [List.map_map]; rfl))
  holder := by rw [h'.holder, h.holder, Holder.ren_comp]
  active := h'.active.trans h.active

/-- Related obligations: leaf membership (§74, §75; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem PinRel.mem_leaves {ob ob' : PinOb} (hr : PinRel π ob ob') (l : Nat) :
    π.f l ∈ ob'.leaves ↔ l ∈ ob.leaves :=
  hr.leaves.mem_iff.trans (π.mem_map_f _ _)

/-- Symmetry of related obligations (§74, §75; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem PinRel.symm {ob ob' : PinOb} (h : PinRel π ob ob') : PinRel π.symm ob' ob where
  place := by rw [h.place]; exact (π.gf _).symm
  leaves := by have := h.leaves.map π.g; rw [Ren.map_gf] at this; exact this.symm
  active := h.active.symm

/-- Transitivity of related obligations (§74, §75; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem PinRel.trans {ob ob' ob'' : PinOb} (h : PinRel π ob ob') (h' : PinRel π' ob' ob'') :
    PinRel (π'.comp π) ob ob'' where
  place := by rw [h'.place, h.place]; rfl
  leaves := h'.leaves.trans ((h.leaves.map π'.f).trans (by rw [List.map_map]; rfl))
  active := h'.active.trans h.active

/-- Symmetry of related states (§38; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.symm (h : SRel π α s s') : SRel π.symm α.symm s' s where
  F := h.F.symm
  nF := h.nF.symm
  P := h.P.symm
  I l := by have := h.I (π.g l); rw [π.fg] at this; exact this.symm
  Alen := h.Alen.symm
  A x := by
    have := optionRel_symm (fun _ _ hy => AuthRel.symm hy) (h.A (α.g x))
    rw [α.fg] at this; exact this
  Afix x hx := by
    have := h.Afix x (h.Alen ▸ hx)
    show α.g x = x
    conv => lhs; rw [← this]
    exact α.gf x
  D q := by
    have := (h.D (π.g q)).map α.g
    rw [π.fg, Ren.map_gf] at this; exact this.symm
  dead q := by have := h.dead (π.g q); rw [π.fg] at this; exact this.symm
  pins o := optionRel_symm (fun _ _ hy => PinRel.symm hy) (h.pins o)

/-- Transitivity of related states (§38; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.trans (h : SRel π α s s') (h' : SRel π' α' s' s'') :
    SRel (π'.comp π) (α'.comp α) s s'' where
  F := h'.F.trans h.F
  nF := h'.nF.trans h.nF
  P := h.P.trans h'.P
  I l := (h'.I (π.f l)).trans (h.I l)
  Alen := h'.Alen.trans h.Alen
  A x := optionRel_trans (fun _ _ _ hy hy' => AuthRel.trans hy hy') (h.A x) (h'.A (α.f x))
  Afix x hx := by
    show α'.f (α.f x) = x
    rw [h.Afix x hx, h'.Afix x (h.Alen ▸ hx)]
  D q := (h'.D (π.f q)).trans (((h.D q).map α'.f).trans (by rw [List.map_map]; rfl))
  dead q := (h'.dead (π.f q)).trans (h.dead q)
  pins o := optionRel_trans (fun _ _ _ hy hy' => PinRel.trans hy hy') (h.pins o) (h'.pins o)

/-- Related states with the same new frame stack are related (§38, §39; §49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.withF (h : SRel π α s s') (F₀ : Frames) :
    SRel π α { s with F := F₀ } { s' with F := F₀ } :=
  { h with F := rfl }

/-- An existing authority has a related authority (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.A_some (h : SRel π α s s') {x : Nat} {y : Authority} (hy : s.A[x]? = some y) :
    ∃ y', s'.A[α.f x]? = some y' ∧ AuthRel π α y y' :=
  optionRel_some (h.A x) hy

/-- An existing renamed authority has a related authority (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.A_some' (h : SRel π α s s') {x : Nat} {y' : Authority}
    (hy : s'.A[α.f x]? = some y') : ∃ y, s.A[x]? = some y ∧ AuthRel π α y y' :=
  optionRel_some' (h.A x) hy

/-- Authorities are absent together (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.A_none (h : SRel π α s s') (x : Nat) : s.A[x]? = none ↔ s'.A[α.f x]? = none :=
  optionRel_none_iff (h.A x)

/-- An existing obligation has a related obligation (§74, §75; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.pins_some (h : SRel π α s s') {o : Nat} {ob : PinOb} (hob : s.pins[o]? = some ob) :
    ∃ ob', s'.pins[o]? = some ob' ∧ PinRel π ob ob' :=
  optionRel_some (h.pins o) hob

/-- An existing obligation of the related state has a related obligation (§74, §75; §49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.pins_some' (h : SRel π α s s') {o : Nat} {ob' : PinOb}
    (hob : s'.pins[o]? = some ob') : ∃ ob, s.pins[o]? = some ob ∧ PinRel π ob ob' :=
  optionRel_some' (h.pins o) hob

/-- Obligations are absent together (§74, §75; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.pins_none (h : SRel π α s s') (o : Nat) : s.pins[o]? = none ↔ s'.pins[o]? = none :=
  optionRel_none_iff (h.pins o)

/-- Related states have related authority bounds (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.Alt (h : SRel π α s s') (x : Nat) : α.f x < s'.A.length ↔ x < s.A.length := by
  have := h.A_none x
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff, List.getElem?_eq_none_iff] at this
  omega

/-- Membership in the authority range, renamed (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.mem_rangeA (h : SRel π α s s') (x : Nat) :
    α.f x ∈ List.range s'.A.length ↔ x ∈ List.range s.A.length := by
  simp only [List.mem_range, h.Alt]

/-- Universal quantification over the authorities, renamed (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.forall_rangeA (h : SRel π α s s') {Q : Nat → Prop} :
    (∀ y ∈ List.range s'.A.length, Q y) ↔ ∀ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, Q (α.f x) :=
  α.forall_mem_iff h.mem_rangeA fun _ => Iff.rfl

/-- Existential quantification over the authorities, renamed (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.exists_rangeA (h : SRel π α s s') {Q : Nat → Prop} :
    (∃ y ∈ List.range s'.A.length, Q y) ↔ ∃ x ∈ List.range s.A.length, Q (α.f x) :=
  α.exists_mem_iff h.mem_rangeA fun _ => Iff.rfl

/-- `WF3` gives downward links (§49.2, §49.5; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem Down.of_wf3 (hw : WF3 s) : Down s := by
  refine ⟨fun _ _ hp => (hw.parent_lt hp).1, fun j o ho => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyo⟩ := Option.bind_eq_some_iff.1 ho
  exact hw.origins j y o hy hyo

/-- Field order kept by `π` is kept by its inverse on the related list (§63.2; §49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem SibMono.symm (hP : PRel π P P') (hs : SibMono π P) : SibMono π.symm P' := by
  have hpar : ∀ x p, parentOf P' x = some p → parentOf P (π.g x) = some (π.g p) := by
    intro x p hx
    have := hP.get (π.g x)
    rw [π.fg] at this
    simp only [parentOf, this] at hx ⊢
    cases e : P[π.g x]? with
    | none => rw [e] at hx; cases hx
    | some pl =>
      rw [e] at hx
      simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some, Place.ren] at hx
      cases hpp : pl.parent with
      | none => rw [hpp] at hx; cases hx
      | some r =>
        rw [hpp] at hx; simp only [Option.map_some, Option.some.injEq] at hx
        simp only [Option.bind_some, hpp, ← hx, π.gf]
  intro x y p hx hy hxy
  simp only [Ren.symm_f]
  rcases Nat.lt_trichotomy (π.g x) (π.g y) with hlt | heq | hgt
  · exact hlt
  · exact absurd ((by rw [← π.fg x, heq, π.fg] : x = y) ▸ hxy) (Nat.lt_irrefl _)
  · have := hs _ _ _ (hpar y p hy) (hpar x p hx) hgt
    rw [π.fg, π.fg] at this; omega

/-- Field order depends only on the parent links (§63.2; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SibMono.congr {P₁ : List Place} (hpar : parentOf P₁ = parentOf P) (hs : SibMono π P) :
    SibMono π P₁ := by
  intro x y p hx hy; rw [hpar] at hx hy; exact hs x y p hx hy

/-- Symmetry of the simulation invariant (§49, last paragraph; §57). -/
theorem Sim.symm (hS : Sim π α s s') : Sim π.symm α.symm s' s where
  rel := hS.rel.symm
  down := hS.down'
  down' := hS.down
  sib := SibMono.symm hS.rel.P hS.sib

/-- The renamed contract corresponds to the contract (§48, §80; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem KCorr.rename (π α : Ren) (k : K) : KCorr π α k (k.rename π α) where
  dd r r' := by simp only [K.rename, Ren.map_gf]
  shared l := by simp only [K.rename, π.gf]
  pinned l := by simp only [K.rename, π.gf]
  done _ := Iff.rfl
  dealloc p := by simp only [K.rename, π.gf]
  compat p a := by simp only [K.rename, π.gf]

/-- Symmetry of corresponding contracts (§48, §80; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem KCorr.symm {k k' : K} (hK : KCorr π α k k') : KCorr π.symm α.symm k' k where
  dd r r' := by
    have := hK.dd (r.map π.g) (r'.map π.g)
    rw [Ren.map_fg, Ren.map_fg] at this; exact this.symm
  shared l := by have := hK.shared (π.g l); rw [π.fg] at this; exact this.symm
  pinned l := by have := hK.pinned (π.g l); rw [π.fg] at this; exact this.symm
  done o := (hK.done o).symm
  dealloc p := by have := hK.dealloc (π.g p); rw [π.fg] at this; exact this.symm
  compat p a := by have := hK.compat (π.g p) a; rw [π.fg] at this; exact this.symm

/-- `DDSound` (§80, §23) is invariant under renaming of the contract (§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem ddSound_rename (π α : Ren) (k : K) : DDSound (k.rename π α) ↔ DDSound k := by
  constructor
  · intro h r r' hd l hl hl'
    have hd' : (k.rename π α).DeclaredDisjoint (r.map π.f) (r'.map π.f) := by
      simp only [K.rename, Ren.map_gf]; exact hd
    exact h _ _ hd' (π.f l) ((π.mem_map_f _ _).2 hl) ((π.mem_map_f _ _).2 hl')
  · intro h r r' hd l hl hl'
    exact h _ _ hd (π.g l) (List.mem_map_of_mem hl) (List.mem_map_of_mem hl')

/-- Guarded steps with corresponding preconditions and related effects correspond (§58; §49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem guarded_corr {Pre Pre' : Prop} {e e' : S3} (hp : Pre' ↔ Pre)
    (he : Pre → SRel π α e e') : StepCorr π α (Guarded Pre e) (Guarded Pre' e') := by
  constructor
  · intro o ho
    cases ho with
    | ok hpre => exact ⟨.ok e', .ok (hp.2 hpre), he hpre⟩
    | reject hpre => exact ⟨.reject, .reject (fun h' => hpre (hp.1 h')), trivial⟩
  · intro o' ho'
    cases ho' with
    | ok hpre => exact ⟨.ok e, .ok (hp.1 hpre), he (hp.1 hpre)⟩
    | reject hpre => exact ⟨.reject, .reject (fun h => hpre (hp.2 h)), trivial⟩

end

/-- Renaming the arguments by the inverse, then by the renaming, gives the operation back (§60–§75;
§49, last paragraph). -/
theorem KernelOp.ren_symm_ren (π α : Ren) (op : KernelOp) :
    (op.ren π.symm α.symm).ren π α = op := by
  cases op <;>
    simp [KernelOp.ren, List.map_map, Function.comp_def, π.fg, α.fg]

/-- Renaming the arguments, then by the inverse, gives the operation back (§60–§75; §49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem KernelOp.symm_ren_ren (π α : Ren) (op : KernelOp) :
    (op.ren π α).ren π.symm α.symm = op :=
  KernelOp.ren_symm_ren π.symm α.symm op

end Rename

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access

namespace Frames

/-! ## Lists -/

/-- Indices of `List.range` are strictly increasing (§72: identities of the root locals). -/
theorem range_pairwise_lt : ∀ n, (List.range n).Pairwise (· < ·)
  | 0 => by simp
  | n + 1 => by
    rw [List.range_succ, List.pairwise_append]
    refine ⟨range_pairwise_lt n, List.pairwise_singleton _ _, fun a ha b hb => ?_⟩
    rw [List.mem_singleton] at hb; subst hb; exact List.mem_range.1 ha

/-- In a strictly increasing list, a value sits at one index only (§72: identities of the root
locals). -/
theorem getElem?_inj_of_lt : ∀ {l : List Nat} {i j x : Nat}, l.Pairwise (· < ·) →
    l[i]? = some x → l[j]? = some x → i = j
  | [], _, _, _, _, h, _ => by simp at h
  | _ :: _, 0, 0, _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | _ :: l, 0, j + 1, x, hp, hi, hj => by
    simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.some.injEq] at hi; subst hi
    have := (List.pairwise_cons.1 hp).1 _ (List.mem_of_getElem? hj)
    exact absurd this (Nat.lt_irrefl _)
  | _ :: l, i + 1, 0, x, hp, hi, hj => by
    simp only [List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.some.injEq] at hj; subst hj
    have := (List.pairwise_cons.1 hp).1 _ (List.mem_of_getElem? hi)
    exact absurd this (Nat.lt_irrefl _)
  | _ :: l, i + 1, j + 1, x, hp, hi, hj => by
    simp only [List.getElem?_cons_succ] at hi hj
    rw [getElem?_inj_of_lt (List.pairwise_cons.1 hp).2 hi hj]

/-- A member of a list sits at some index (§72: the root locals). -/
theorem exists_getElem?_of_mem {α : Type} {a : α} : ∀ {l : List α}, a ∈ l →
    ∃ k : Nat, l[k]? = some a
  | b :: l, h => by
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 h with rfl | h
    · exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_getElem?_of_mem h; exact ⟨k + 1, by simpa using hk⟩

/-- An element of the mapped suffix of an appended list has an index (§72: the root authorities
of the locals). -/
theorem append_map_get {α β : Type} (A₀ : List β) (g : α → β) {l : List α} {a : α} (h : a ∈ l) :
    ∃ j, (A₀ ++ l.map g)[A₀.length + j]? = some (g a) := by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_getElem?_of_mem h
  exact ⟨j, by rw [List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_add_right _ _), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left,
    List.getElem?_map, hj]; rfl⟩

/-! ## Shapes of locals (§72.2) -/

/-- A local shape has as many elements as its shape (§72). -/
theorem toShape_length (ls : LocalShape) : ls.toShape.length = ls.length := by
  simp [LocalShape.toShape]

/-- No local has an owning element (§72, §39: locals are owned by the new frame). -/
theorem toShape_owner (ls : LocalShape) (i : Nat) : (ls.toShape[i]?).bind (·.2.1) = none := by
  simp only [LocalShape.toShape, List.getElem?_map]; cases ls[i]? <;> rfl

/-- Every local is owned by the receiving holder (§72 `ok` effect, §39). -/
theorem shapeOwner_toShape (ls : LocalShape) (hd : Holder) (i : Nat) :
    shapeOwner ls.toShape hd i = hd := by
  simp only [shapeOwner, toShape_owner]

/-- Root locals are elements of the shape without parent (§40, §72). -/
theorem rootIdx_mem {ls : LocalShape} {k i : Nat} (h : (rootIdx ls.toShape)[k]? = some i) :
    i < ls.length ∧ (ls.toShape[i]?).bind (·.1) = none := by
  have := List.mem_of_getElem? h
  simp only [rootIdx, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, Option.isNone_iff_eq_none] at this
  rw [toShape_length] at this; exact this

/-- An element without parent is a root local (§40, §72). -/
theorem mem_rootIdx {ls : LocalShape} {k : Nat} (hk : k < ls.length)
    (hn : (ls.toShape[k]?).bind (·.1) = none) : k ∈ rootIdx ls.toShape := by
  simp only [rootIdx, List.mem_filter, List.mem_range, toShape_length, hk, hn,
    Option.isNone_none, and_self]

/-- Root locals have distinct positions (§72: one root authority per root local). -/
theorem rootIdx_inj {ls : LocalShape} {k k' i : Nat} (h : (rootIdx ls.toShape)[k]? = some i)
    (h' : (rootIdx ls.toShape)[k']? = some i) : k = k' :=
  getElem?_inj_of_lt ((range_pairwise_lt _).filter _) h h'

/-- The parent of a local is an earlier local (§72.2, `ShapeOK`). -/
theorem shape_parent {n : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} (hsh : ShapeOK n ls.toShape) {i r : Nat}
    (hi : i < ls.length) (hr : (ls.toShape[i]?).bind (·.1) = some r) : n ≤ r ∧ r < n + i := by
  have := (hsh i (List.mem_range.2 (by rw [toShape_length]; exact hi))).1
  rw [hr] at this; exact ⟨this.1, this.2.1⟩

/-! ## Origin chains and effective anchors (§42, §44) -/

/-- Under the origin order of `WF3` (§49.5), the origin of an authority precedes it. -/
theorem org_lt {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) {x o : Nat} (h : s.org x = some o) : o < x := by
  simp only [S3.org] at h
  cases hy : s.A[x]? with
  | none => rw [hy] at h; cases h
  | some y => rw [hy] at h; exact hw.origins x y o hy h

/-- One step of an origin chain (§42): the chain starts with the origin when it is smaller, or
it is empty. -/
theorem ancs_step {s : S3} {x o : Nat} (h : s.org x = some o) :
    (o < x ∧ s.ancs x = o :: s.ancs o) ∨ s.ancs x = [] := by
  by_cases hlt : o < x
  · exact .inl ⟨hlt, chain_cons h hlt⟩
  · right; unfold S3.ancs chain
    cases x with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k => simp [chainF, h, hlt]

/-- Under the origin order of `WF3` (§49.5), the origin chain of `x` reaches a root authority:
some element of `x` and its ancestors has no origin. -/
theorem reaches_root {s : S3} (hw : WF3 s) :
    ∀ n x, x < n → ∃ r, (r = x ∨ r ∈ s.ancs x) ∧ s.org r = none
  | 0, _, h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | n + 1, x, hx => by
    cases ho : s.org x with
    | none => exact ⟨x, .inl rfl, ho⟩
    | some o =>
      have hlt := org_lt hw ho
      obtain ⟨r, hr, hro⟩ := reaches_root hw n o (by omega)
      refine ⟨r, .inr ?_, hro⟩
      rw [S3.ancs, chain_cons ho hlt]
      rcases hr with rfl | hr
      · exact List.mem_cons_self ..
      · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hr
namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

namespace Alloc

/-! ## Shape of the new places (§71.1, §71 `ok`) -/

/-- Every element of a local shape is owned by the receiving holder (§71.1: the shape is
represented like the locals of `enterFrame`, which have no owning element). -/
theorem shapeOwner_toShape (ls : LocalShape) (hd : Holder) (i : Nat) :
    shapeOwner ls.toShape hd i = hd := by
  simp only [shapeOwner, LocalShape.toShape, List.getElem?_map]
  cases ls[i]? <;> rfl

/-- A local shape has one element per entry (§71.1). -/
theorem length_toShape (ls : LocalShape) : ls.toShape.length = ls.length := by
  simp [LocalShape.toShape]

/-- The places after `alloc` are the former places followed by the elements of the shape (§71,
`ok`: fresh identities). -/
theorem allocP_len (s : S3) (ow : Nat) (ls : LocalShape) :
    (allocP s ow ls).length = s.P.length + ls.length := by
  simp [allocP, shapeP, LocalShape.toShape]

/-- `alloc` keeps the former places (§71, `ok`). -/
theorem allocP_lt {s : S3} {ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {q : Nat} (h : q < s.P.length) :
    (allocP s ow ls)[q]? = s.P[q]? := List.getElem?_append_left h

/-- The new place of index `|P| + i` has the parent given by the shape and is owned by `owner`
(§71, `ok`: owned by `owner`). -/
theorem allocP_new {s : S3} {ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {i : Nat} (h : i < ls.length) :
    (allocP s ow ls)[s.P.length + i]? =
      some ⟨(ls.toShape[i]?).bind (·.1), .place ow, ((ls.toShape[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩ := by
  have h' : i < ls.toShape.length := by rw [length_toShape]; exact h
  simp only [allocP, shapeP, List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_add_right _ _),
    Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, List.getElem?_map, List.getElem?_range h', Option.map_some,
    shapeOwner_toShape]

/-- A place after `alloc` is a former place, or a new element of the shape owned by `owner`
(§71, `ok`). -/
theorem allocP_get {s : S3} {ow : Nat} {ls : LocalShape} {q : Nat} {pl : Place}
    (h : (allocP s ow ls)[q]? = some pl) :
    (q < s.P.length ∧ s.P[q]? = some pl) ∨
    (s.P.length ≤ q ∧ q < s.P.length + ls.length ∧
      pl.parent = (ls.toShape[q - s.P.length]?).bind (·.1) ∧ pl.owner = .place ow) := by
  by_cases hq : q < s.P.length
  · exact .inl ⟨hq, by rwa [allocP_lt hq] at h⟩

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename.Basic

/-!
# Renaming of identities: places

Equivariance of the place-level notions of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` under a
renaming of identities (§49, last paragraph): parent chains, parts, leaves and footprints (§40),
overlap (§63.3), transitive ownership (§40), root places (§40), released units (§70), children,
positional correspondence and same shape (§63.2), holders within a value and their move (§63),
and the places appended from a shape (§47, §71, §72).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename

variable {π : Ren} {P P' : List Place}

/-- A renamed option is a renamed `some` exactly when the option is that `some` (§49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.option_map_eq_some (π : Ren) (o : Option Nat) (x : Nat) :
    o.map π.f = some (π.f x) ↔ o = some x := by
  cases o <;> simp [Ren.f_inj]

/-! ## Chains, parts, leaves, footprints (§40) -/

/-- Chains along links related by an injective map, both downward, correspond (§40 parents, §42
origins; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem chain_ren {org org' : Nat → Option Nat} {f : Nat → Nat}
    (hd : ∀ j o, org j = some o → o < j) (hd' : ∀ j o, org' j = some o → o < j)
    (h : ∀ j, org' (f j) = (org j).map f) : ∀ i, chain org' (f i) = (chain org i).map f := by
  intro i
  induction i using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ i ih =>
    cases ho : org i with
    | none => rw [chain_none ho, chain_none (by rw [h, ho]; rfl)]; rfl
    | some o =>
      have h' : org' (f i) = some (f o) := by rw [h, ho]; rfl
      rw [chain_cons ho (hd _ _ ho), chain_cons h' (hd' _ _ h'), ih o (hd _ _ ho)]
      rfl

/-- Structural parents of related place lists correspond (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem PRel.parentOf (hP : PRel π P P') (q : Nat) :
    parentOf P' (π.f q) = (parentOf P q).map π.f := by
  simp only [Ern.MemoryModel.Access.parentOf, hP.get]
  cases P[q]? <;> simp [Place.ren]

/-- A renamed place has the renamed parent exactly when the place has that parent (§40; §49,
last paragraph). -/
theorem PRel.parentOf_eq_some (hP : PRel π P P') (q p : Nat) :
    parentOf P' (π.f q) = some (π.f p) ↔ parentOf P q = some p := by
  rw [hP.parentOf, π.option_map_eq_some]

/-- Structural parent chains correspond (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem chainP_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (q : Nat) :
    chain (parentOf P') (π.f q) = (chain (parentOf P) q).map π.f :=
  chain_ren hd hd' hP.parentOf q

/-- `partOf` is invariant (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem partOf_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (p q : Nat) :
    partOf P' (π.f p) (π.f q) ↔ partOf P p q := by
  simp only [partOf, hP.lt_iff, chainP_ren hP hd hd', π.mem_map_f, Ren.f_inj]

/-- Leaves are invariant (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem isLeaf_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (l : Nat) : isLeaf P' (π.f l) ↔ isLeaf P l := by
  unfold isLeaf
  refine π.forall_iff fun r => ?_
  rw [hP.lt_iff, Ne, hP.parentOf_eq_some]

/-- `footprint` membership is invariant (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem mem_footprint_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (l q : Nat) :
    π.f l ∈ footprint P' (π.f q) ↔ l ∈ footprint P q := by
  simp only [mem_footprint, hP.lt_iff, isLeaf_ren hP, partOf_ren hP hd hd']

/-- A footprint has no duplicate (§40: a set of leaves). -/
theorem footprint_nodup (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : (footprint P q).Nodup :=
  List.Pairwise.filter _ List.nodup_range

/-- Footprints correspond up to permutation (§40, §42: a set; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem footprint_perm_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (q : Nat) :
    (footprint P' (π.f q)).Perm ((footprint P q).map π.f) :=
  π.perm_of_mem (footprint_nodup P q) (footprint_nodup P' _) fun l => mem_footprint_ren hP hd hd' l q

/-- `overlap` is invariant (§63.3; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem overlap_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (p q : Nat) :
    overlap P' (π.f p) (π.f q) ↔ overlap P p q :=
  π.exists_mem_iff (fun x => mem_footprint_ren hP hd hd' x p)
    (fun x => mem_footprint_ren hP hd hd' x q)

/-! ## Ownership, root places, released units (§40, §70) -/

/-- `OwnedIn` is preserved forward (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem ownedIn_ren_of (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') {src q : Nat}
    (h : OwnedIn P src q) : OwnedIn P' (π.f src) (π.f q) := by
  induction h with
  | direct hpl ho hp =>
    exact .direct (by rw [hP.get, hpl]; rfl) (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren])
      ((partOf_ren hP hd hd' _ _).2 hp)
  | step hpl ho _ ih =>
    exact .step (by rw [hP.get, hpl]; rfl) (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren]) ih

/-- `OwnedIn` is invariant (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem ownedIn_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (src q : Nat) :
    OwnedIn P' (π.f src) (π.f q) ↔ OwnedIn P src q :=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa only [Ren.symm_f, π.gf] using ownedIn_ren_of hP.symm hd' hd h,
   ownedIn_ren_of hP hd hd'⟩

/-- Root places are invariant (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem rootPlace_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (r : Nat) : RootPlace P' (π.f r) ↔ RootPlace P r := by
  simp only [RootPlace, hP.lt_iff, hP.parentOf, Option.map_eq_none_iff]

/-- Places of a released unit are invariant (§70; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem freedPlace_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (p q : Nat) :
    FreedPlace P' (π.f p) (π.f q) ↔ FreedPlace P p q := by
  simp only [FreedPlace, partOf_ren hP hd hd', ownedIn_ren hP hd hd']

/-! ## Children, correspondence, same shape (§63.2) -/

/-- Children are listed in increasing index order (§63.2). -/
theorem kids_sorted (P : List Place) (x : Nat) : (kids P x).Pairwise (· < ·) :=
  List.pairwise_lt_range.filter _

/-- Children correspond in order when `π` keeps field order (§63.2; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem kids_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hs : SibMono π P) (x : Nat) :
    kids P' (π.f x) = (kids P x).map π.f := by
  apply eq_of_sorted_mem (kids_sorted P' _)
  · rw [List.pairwise_map]
    refine (kids_sorted P x).imp_of_mem fun {a b} ha hb hab => ?_
    exact hs a b x (mem_kids.1 ha).2 (mem_kids.1 hb).2 hab
  · intro a
    rw [← π.fg a, π.mem_map_f, mem_kids, mem_kids, hP.lt_iff, hP.parentOf_eq_some]

/-- `corr` of a part without parent other than `src` is undefined (§63.2). -/
theorem corr_none {src dst r : Nat} (hr : r ≠ src) (hp : parentOf P r = none) :
    corr P src dst r = none := by
  unfold corr; cases r <;> simp [corrF, hr, hp]

/-- `corr` is equivariant when `π` keeps field order (§63.2; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem corr_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (hs : SibMono π P)
    (src dst : Nat) : ∀ r, corr P' (π.f src) (π.f dst) (π.f r) = (corr P src dst r).map π.f := by
  intro r
  induction r using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ r ih =>
    by_cases hr : r = src
    · subst hr; rw [corr_src, corr_src]; rfl
    · have hr' : π.f r ≠ π.f src := fun e => hr ((Ren.f_inj π).1 e)
      cases hp : parentOf P r with
      | none =>
        rw [corr_none hr hp, corr_none hr' (by rw [hP.parentOf, hp]; rfl)]; rfl
      | some p =>
        have hp' : parentOf P' (π.f r) = some (π.f p) := by rw [hP.parentOf, hp]; rfl
        rw [corr_step hr hp (hd _ _ hp), corr_step hr' hp' (hd' _ _ hp'), ih p (hd _ _ hp),
          kids_ren hP hs p, posIn_map (fun _ _ e => (Ren.f_inj π).1 e)]
        cases corr P src dst p with
        | none => rfl
        | some p0 =>
          simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some, kids_ren hP hs p0, List.getElem?_map]

/-- `SameShape` is invariant when `π` keeps field order (§63.2; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem sameShape_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (hs : SibMono π P)
    (src dst : Nat) : SameShape P' (π.f src) (π.f dst) ↔ SameShape P src dst := by
  unfold SameShape
  refine and_congr (π.forall_mem_iff hP.mem_range fun r => ?_)
    (π.forall_mem_iff hP.mem_range fun z => ?_)
  · rw [partOf_ren hP hd hd', corr_ren hP hd hd' hs]
    refine imp_congr_right fun _ => ?_
    cases corr P src dst r with
    | none => exact Iff.rfl
    | some c => simp only [Option.map_some, OptP, kids_ren hP hs, List.length_map]
  · rw [partOf_ren hP hd hd']
    refine imp_congr_right fun _ => π.exists_mem_iff hP.mem_range fun r => ?_
    rw [partOf_ren hP hd hd', corr_ren hP hd hd' hs, π.option_map_eq_some]

/-! ## Holders within a value and their move (§63, §69, §70) -/

/-- `heldIn` is invariant (§63, §69, §70; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem heldIn_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (q : Nat) (o : Holder) :
    heldIn P' (π.f q) (o.ren π) ↔ heldIn P q o := by
  cases o with
  | frame f => exact Iff.rfl
  | place r => exact partOf_ren hP hd hd' r q

/-- The move of a holder by `transfer` is equivariant when `π` keeps field order (§63, `ok`
effect; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem mvTo_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (hs : SibMono π P)
    (src dst : Nat) (o : Holder) :
    mvTo P' (π.f src) (π.f dst) (o.ren π) = (mvTo P src dst o).ren π := by
  cases o with
  | frame f => rfl
  | place r => simp only [Holder.ren, mvTo, corr_ren hP hd hd' hs, Option.getD_map]

/-! ## Places appended from a shape (§47, §71, §72) -/

/-- The former places of `shapeP` (§47, §71, §72). -/
theorem shapeP_get_old {hd : Holder} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {q : Nat}
    (hq : q < P.length) : (shapeP P hd ls)[q]? = P[q]? :=
  List.getElem?_append_left hq

/-- The appended places of `shapeP` (§47, §71, §72). -/
theorem shapeP_get_new (P : List Place) (hd : Holder) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat))
    (i : Nat) : (shapeP P hd ls)[P.length + i]? = if i < ls.length then
      some ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), shapeOwner ls hd i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩ else none := by
  simp only [shapeP, List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_add_right _ _), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left,
    List.getElem?_map]
  split
  · rename_i hi; rw [List.getElem?_range hi]; rfl
  · rename_i hi
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (by simp only [List.length_range]; omega)]; rfl

/-- Parents of the former places of `shapeP` (§47, §71, §72). -/
theorem shapeP_parentOf_old {hd : Holder} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {q : Nat}
    (hq : q < P.length) : parentOf (shapeP P hd ls) q = parentOf P q := by
  simp only [Ern.MemoryModel.Access.parentOf, shapeP_get_old hq]

/-- Parents of the appended places of `shapeP` (§47, §71, §72). -/
theorem shapeP_parentOf_new (P : List Place) (hd : Holder)
    (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (i : Nat) :
    parentOf (shapeP P hd ls) (P.length + i) = (ls[i]?).bind (·.1) := by
  simp only [Ern.MemoryModel.Access.parentOf, shapeP_get_new]
  split
  · rfl
  · rename_i hi; rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (by omega)]; rfl

/-- Appending a well-formed shape keeps the relation, the shape not renamed (§71.1, §72.2:
parents and owning elements are fresh; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem shapeP_ren (hP : PRel π P P') {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    (hok : ShapeOK P.length ls) (o : Holder) :
    PRel π (shapeP P o ls) (shapeP P' (o.ren π) ls) where
  len := by simp [shapeP, hP.len]
  get q := by
    by_cases hq : q < P.length
    · rw [shapeP_get_old ((hP.lt_iff q).2 hq), shapeP_get_old hq, hP.get]
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, q = P.length + i := ⟨q - P.length, by omega⟩
      rw [hP.fix _ (Nat.le_add_right _ _), ← hP.len, shapeP_get_new, hP.len, shapeP_get_new]
      split
      · rename_i hi
        have hc := hok i (List.mem_range.2 hi)
        simp only [Option.map_some, Place.ren, Option.some.injEq, Place.mk.injEq, and_true]
        constructor
        · have h1 := hc.1
          revert h1
          cases (ls[i]?).bind (·.1) with
          | none => intro; rfl
          | some r => intro h1; simp only [Option.map_some, hP.fix r h1.1]
        · have h2 := hc.2
          revert h2
          unfold shapeOwner
          cases (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
          | none => intro; rfl
          | some r => intro h2; simp only [Holder.ren, hP.fix r h2.1]
      · rfl
  fix q hq := hP.fix q (Nat.le_trans (by simp [shapeP]) hq)

/-- Appending a well-formed shape keeps parent links downward (§71.1, §72.2; §49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem shapeP_down (hdP : DownP P) {o : Holder} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    (hok : ShapeOK P.length ls) : DownP (shapeP P o ls) := by
  intro j p hj
  by_cases hq : j < P.length
  · rw [shapeP_parentOf_old hq] at hj; exact hdP j p hj
  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, j = P.length + i := ⟨j - P.length, by omega⟩
    rw [shapeP_parentOf_new] at hj
    have hi : i < ls.length := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hi
      rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (by omega)] at hj; cases hj
    have hc := (hok i (List.mem_range.2 hi)).1
    rw [hj] at hc; exact hc.2.1

/-- Appending places keeps field order (§63.2, §71, §72; §49, last paragraph): appended places are
fixed and follow the former ones. -/
theorem shapeP_sib (hP : PRel π P P') (hs : SibMono π P) {o : Holder}
    {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} : SibMono π (shapeP P o ls) := by
  intro x y p hx hy hxy
  by_cases hyP : y < P.length
  · have hxP : x < P.length := by omega
    rw [shapeP_parentOf_old hxP] at hx; rw [shapeP_parentOf_old hyP] at hy
    exact hs x y p hx hy hxy
  · rw [hP.fix y (by omega)]
    by_cases hxP : x < P.length
    · have := (hP.lt_iff x).2 hxP; rw [hP.len] at this; omega
    · rw [hP.fix x (by omega)]; exact hxy

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename.Basic

/-!
# Renaming of identities: places

Equivariance of the place-level notions of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` under a
renaming of identities (§49, last paragraph): parent chains, parts, leaves and footprints (§40),
overlap (§63.3), transitive ownership (§40), root places (§40), released units (§70), children,
positional correspondence and same shape (§63.2), holders within a value and their move (§63),
and the places appended from a shape (§47, §71, §72).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename

variable {π : Ren} {P P' : List Place}

/-- A renamed option is a renamed `some` exactly when the option is that `some` (§49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem Ren.option_map_eq_some (π : Ren) (o : Option Nat) (x : Nat) :
    o.map π.f = some (π.f x) ↔ o = some x := by
  cases o <;> simp [Ren.f_inj]

/-! ## Chains, parts, leaves, footprints (§40) -/

/-- Chains along links related by an injective map, both downward, correspond (§40 parents, §42
origins; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem chain_ren {org org' : Nat → Option Nat} {f : Nat → Nat}
    (hd : ∀ j o, org j = some o → o < j) (hd' : ∀ j o, org' j = some o → o < j)
    (h : ∀ j, org' (f j) = (org j).map f) : ∀ i, chain org' (f i) = (chain org i).map f := by
  intro i
  induction i using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ i ih =>
    cases ho : org i with
    | none => rw [chain_none ho, chain_none (by rw [h, ho]; rfl)]; rfl
    | some o =>
      have h' : org' (f i) = some (f o) := by rw [h, ho]; rfl
      rw [chain_cons ho (hd _ _ ho), chain_cons h' (hd' _ _ h'), ih o (hd _ _ ho)]
      rfl

/-- Structural parents of related place lists correspond (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem PRel.parentOf (hP : PRel π P P') (q : Nat) :
    parentOf P' (π.f q) = (parentOf P q).map π.f := by
  simp only [Ern.MemoryModel.Access.parentOf, hP.get]
  cases P[q]? <;> simp [Place.ren]

/-- A renamed place has the renamed parent exactly when the place has that parent (§40; §49,
last paragraph). -/
theorem PRel.parentOf_eq_some (hP : PRel π P P') (q p : Nat) :
    parentOf P' (π.f q) = some (π.f p) ↔ parentOf P q = some p := by
  rw [hP.parentOf, π.option_map_eq_some]

/-- Structural parent chains correspond (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem chainP_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (q : Nat) :
    chain (parentOf P') (π.f q) = (chain (parentOf P) q).map π.f :=
  chain_ren hd hd' hP.parentOf q

/-- `partOf` is invariant (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem partOf_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (p q : Nat) :
    partOf P' (π.f p) (π.f q) ↔ partOf P p q := by
  simp only [partOf, hP.lt_iff, chainP_ren hP hd hd', π.mem_map_f, Ren.f_inj]

/-- Leaves are invariant (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem isLeaf_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (l : Nat) : isLeaf P' (π.f l) ↔ isLeaf P l := by
  unfold isLeaf
  refine π.forall_iff fun r => ?_
  rw [hP.lt_iff, Ne, hP.parentOf_eq_some]

/-- `footprint` membership is invariant (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem mem_footprint_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (l q : Nat) :
    π.f l ∈ footprint P' (π.f q) ↔ l ∈ footprint P q := by
  simp only [mem_footprint, hP.lt_iff, isLeaf_ren hP, partOf_ren hP hd hd']

/-- A footprint has no duplicate (§40: a set of leaves). -/
theorem footprint_nodup (P : List Place) (q : Nat) : (footprint P q).Nodup :=
  List.Pairwise.filter _ List.nodup_range

/-- Footprints correspond up to permutation (§40, §42: a set; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem footprint_perm_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (q : Nat) :
    (footprint P' (π.f q)).Perm ((footprint P q).map π.f) :=
  π.perm_of_mem (footprint_nodup P q) (footprint_nodup P' _) fun l => mem_footprint_ren hP hd hd' l q

/-- `overlap` is invariant (§63.3; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem overlap_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (p q : Nat) :
    overlap P' (π.f p) (π.f q) ↔ overlap P p q :=
  π.exists_mem_iff (fun x => mem_footprint_ren hP hd hd' x p)
    (fun x => mem_footprint_ren hP hd hd' x q)

/-! ## Ownership, root places, released units (§40, §70) -/

/-- `OwnedIn` is preserved forward (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem ownedIn_ren_of (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') {src q : Nat}
    (h : OwnedIn P src q) : OwnedIn P' (π.f src) (π.f q) := by
  induction h with
  | direct hpl ho hp =>
    exact .direct (by rw [hP.get, hpl]; rfl) (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren])
      ((partOf_ren hP hd hd' _ _).2 hp)
  | step hpl ho _ ih =>
    exact .step (by rw [hP.get, hpl]; rfl) (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren]) ih

/-- `OwnedIn` is invariant (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem ownedIn_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (src q : Nat) :
    OwnedIn P' (π.f src) (π.f q) ↔ OwnedIn P src q :=
  ⟨fun h => by simpa only [Ren.symm_f, π.gf] using ownedIn_ren_of hP.symm hd' hd h,
   ownedIn_ren_of hP hd hd'⟩

/-- Root places are invariant (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem rootPlace_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (r : Nat) : RootPlace P' (π.f r) ↔ RootPlace P r := by
  simp only [RootPlace, hP.lt_iff, hP.parentOf, Option.map_eq_none_iff]

/-- Places of a released unit are invariant (§70; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem freedPlace_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (p q : Nat) :
    FreedPlace P' (π.f p) (π.f q) ↔ FreedPlace P p q := by
  simp only [FreedPlace, partOf_ren hP hd hd', ownedIn_ren hP hd hd']

/-! ## Children, correspondence, same shape (§63.2) -/

/-- Children are listed in increasing index order (§63.2). -/
theorem kids_sorted (P : List Place) (x : Nat) : (kids P x).Pairwise (· < ·) :=
  List.pairwise_lt_range.filter _

/-- Children correspond in order when `π` keeps field order (§63.2; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem kids_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hs : SibMono π P) (x : Nat) :
    kids P' (π.f x) = (kids P x).map π.f := by
  apply eq_of_sorted_mem (kids_sorted P' _)
  · rw [List.pairwise_map]
    refine (kids_sorted P x).imp_of_mem fun {a b} ha hb hab => ?_
    exact hs a b x (mem_kids.1 ha).2 (mem_kids.1 hb).2 hab
  · intro a
    rw [← π.fg a, π.mem_map_f, mem_kids, mem_kids, hP.lt_iff, hP.parentOf_eq_some]

/-- `corr` of a part without parent other than `src` is undefined (§63.2). -/
theorem corr_none {src dst r : Nat} (hr : r ≠ src) (hp : parentOf P r = none) :
    corr P src dst r = none := by
  unfold corr; cases r <;> simp [corrF, hr, hp]

/-- `corr` is equivariant when `π` keeps field order (§63.2; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem corr_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (hs : SibMono π P)
    (src dst : Nat) : ∀ r, corr P' (π.f src) (π.f dst) (π.f r) = (corr P src dst r).map π.f := by
  intro r
  induction r using Nat.strongRecOn with
  | _ r ih =>
    by_cases hr : r = src
    · subst hr; rw [corr_src, corr_src]; rfl
    · have hr' : π.f r ≠ π.f src := fun e => hr ((Ren.f_inj π).1 e)
      cases hp : parentOf P r with
      | none =>
        rw [corr_none hr hp, corr_none hr' (by rw [hP.parentOf, hp]; rfl)]; rfl
      | some p =>
        have hp' : parentOf P' (π.f r) = some (π.f p) := by rw [hP.parentOf, hp]; rfl
        rw [corr_step hr hp (hd _ _ hp), corr_step hr' hp' (hd' _ _ hp'), ih p (hd _ _ hp),
          kids_ren hP hs p, posIn_map (fun _ _ e => (Ren.f_inj π).1 e)]
        cases corr P src dst p with
        | none => rfl
        | some p0 =>
          simp only [Option.map_some, Option.bind_some, kids_ren hP hs p0, List.getElem?_map]

/-- `SameShape` is invariant when `π` keeps field order (§63.2; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem sameShape_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (hs : SibMono π P)
    (src dst : Nat) : SameShape P' (π.f src) (π.f dst) ↔ SameShape P src dst := by
  unfold SameShape
  refine and_congr (π.forall_mem_iff hP.mem_range fun r => ?_)
    (π.forall_mem_iff hP.mem_range fun z => ?_)
  · rw [partOf_ren hP hd hd', corr_ren hP hd hd' hs]
    refine imp_congr_right fun _ => ?_
    cases corr P src dst r with
    | none => exact Iff.rfl
    | some c => simp only [Option.map_some, OptP, kids_ren hP hs, List.length_map]
  · rw [partOf_ren hP hd hd']
    refine imp_congr_right fun _ => π.exists_mem_iff hP.mem_range fun r => ?_
    rw [partOf_ren hP hd hd', corr_ren hP hd hd' hs, π.option_map_eq_some]

/-! ## Holders within a value and their move (§63, §69, §70) -/

/-- `heldIn` is invariant (§63, §69, §70; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem heldIn_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (q : Nat) (o : Holder) :
    heldIn P' (π.f q) (o.ren π) ↔ heldIn P q o := by
  cases o with
  | frame f => exact Iff.rfl
  | place r => exact partOf_ren hP hd hd' r q

/-- The move of a holder by `transfer` is equivariant when `π` keeps field order (§63, `ok`
effect; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem mvTo_ren (hP : PRel π P P') (hd : DownP P) (hd' : DownP P') (hs : SibMono π P)
    (src dst : Nat) (o : Holder) :
    mvTo P' (π.f src) (π.f dst) (o.ren π) = (mvTo P src dst o).ren π := by
  cases o with
  | frame f => rfl
  | place r => simp only [Holder.ren, mvTo, corr_ren hP hd hd' hs, Option.getD_map]

/-! ## Places appended from a shape (§47, §71, §72) -/

/-- The former places of `shapeP` (§47, §71, §72). -/
theorem shapeP_get_old {hd : Holder} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {q : Nat}
    (hq : q < P.length) : (shapeP P hd ls)[q]? = P[q]? :=
  List.getElem?_append_left hq

/-- The appended places of `shapeP` (§47, §71, §72). -/
theorem shapeP_get_new (P : List Place) (hd : Holder) (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat))
    (i : Nat) : (shapeP P hd ls)[P.length + i]? = if i < ls.length then
      some ⟨(ls[i]?).bind (·.1), shapeOwner ls hd i, ((ls[i]?).map (·.2.2)).getD 0⟩ else none := by
  simp only [shapeP, List.getElem?_append_right (Nat.le_add_right _ _), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left,
    List.getElem?_map]
  split
  · rename_i hi; rw [List.getElem?_range hi]; rfl
  · rename_i hi
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (by simp only [List.length_range]; omega)]; rfl

/-- Parents of the former places of `shapeP` (§47, §71, §72). -/
theorem shapeP_parentOf_old {hd : Holder} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} {q : Nat}
    (hq : q < P.length) : parentOf (shapeP P hd ls) q = parentOf P q := by
  simp only [Ern.MemoryModel.Access.parentOf, shapeP_get_old hq]

/-- Parents of the appended places of `shapeP` (§47, §71, §72). -/
theorem shapeP_parentOf_new (P : List Place) (hd : Holder)
    (ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)) (i : Nat) :
    parentOf (shapeP P hd ls) (P.length + i) = (ls[i]?).bind (·.1) := by
  simp only [Ern.MemoryModel.Access.parentOf, shapeP_get_new]
  split
  · rfl
  · rename_i hi; rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (by omega)]; rfl

/-- Appending a well-formed shape keeps the relation, the shape not renamed (§71.1, §72.2:
parents and owning elements are fresh; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem shapeP_ren (hP : PRel π P P') {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    (hok : ShapeOK P.length ls) (o : Holder) :
    PRel π (shapeP P o ls) (shapeP P' (o.ren π) ls) where
  len := by simp [shapeP, hP.len]
  get q := by
    by_cases hq : q < P.length
    · rw [shapeP_get_old ((hP.lt_iff q).2 hq), shapeP_get_old hq, hP.get]
    · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, q = P.length + i := ⟨q - P.length, by omega⟩
      rw [hP.fix _ (Nat.le_add_right _ _), ← hP.len, shapeP_get_new, hP.len, shapeP_get_new]
      split
      · rename_i hi
        have hc := hok i (List.mem_range.2 hi)
        simp only [Option.map_some, Place.ren, Option.some.injEq, Place.mk.injEq, and_true]
        constructor
        · have h1 := hc.1
          revert h1
          cases (ls[i]?).bind (·.1) with
          | none => intro; rfl
          | some r => intro h1; simp only [Option.map_some, hP.fix r h1.1]
        · have h2 := hc.2
          revert h2
          unfold shapeOwner
          cases (ls[i]?).bind (·.2.1) with
          | none => intro; rfl
          | some r => intro h2; simp only [Holder.ren, hP.fix r h2.1]
      · rfl
  fix q hq := hP.fix q (Nat.le_trans (by simp [shapeP]) hq)

/-- Appending a well-formed shape keeps parent links downward (§71.1, §72.2; §49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem shapeP_down (hdP : DownP P) {o : Holder} {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)}
    (hok : ShapeOK P.length ls) : DownP (shapeP P o ls) := by
  intro j p hj
  by_cases hq : j < P.length
  · rw [shapeP_parentOf_old hq] at hj; exact hdP j p hj
  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ : ∃ i, j = P.length + i := ⟨j - P.length, by omega⟩
    rw [shapeP_parentOf_new] at hj
    have hi : i < ls.length := by
      apply Classical.byContradiction; intro hi
      rw [List.getElem?_eq_none_iff.2 (by omega)] at hj; cases hj
    have hc := (hok i (List.mem_range.2 hi)).1
    rw [hj] at hc; exact hc.2.1

/-- Appending places keeps field order (§63.2, §71, §72; §49, last paragraph): appended places are
fixed and follow the former ones. -/
theorem shapeP_sib (hP : PRel π P P') (hs : SibMono π P) {o : Holder}
    {ls : List (Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat)} : SibMono π (shapeP P o ls) := by
  intro x y p hx hy hxy
  by_cases hyP : y < P.length
  · have hxP : x < P.length := by omega
    rw [shapeP_parentOf_old hxP] at hx; rw [shapeP_parentOf_old hyP] at hy
    exact hs x y p hx hy hxy
  · rw [hP.fix y (by omega)]
    by_cases hxP : x < P.length
    · have := (hP.lt_iff x).2 hxP; rw [hP.len] at this; omega
    · rw [hP.fix x (by omega)]; exact hxy

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename.Places

/-!
# Renaming of identities: derived notions of a state

Equivariance of the state-level notions of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.1.md` read by
the operations O1–O16 and by the invariants, under related states (§38; §49, last paragraph): the
current frame (§39), origin chains and effective anchors (§42, §44), activity (§42), usability,
frames of places and live holders (§40, §49.8), effective modes (§43), exercise and the
grounding of a right (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3), dependencies (§44), anchor order (§44, §54),
dynamic pinning (§74) and leaves of usable places (§66.1).

Iff lemmas are proved in one direction and closed by symmetry (`SRel.symm`).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename

variable {π α : Ren} {s s' : S3}

/-! ## Frames, origins, activity (§39, §42, §44) -/

/-- The current frame is kept (§39; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.top (h : SRel π α s s') : s'.top = s.top := by
  unfold S3.top; rw [h.F]

/-- Origin links correspond (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.org (h : SRel π α s s') (j : Nat) : s'.org (α.f j) = (s.org j).map α.f := by
  simp only [S3.org]
  cases hy : s.A[j]? with
  | none => rw [(h.A_none j).1 hy]; rfl
  | some y =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
    rw [hy', Option.bind_some, Option.bind_some, hr.origin]

/-- Origin chains correspond (§42, §43; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.ancs (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (j : Nat) :
    s'.ancs (α.f j) = (s.ancs j).map α.f :=
  chain_ren hd.2 hd'.2 h.org j

/-- Membership in origin chains is invariant (§42, §43; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.mem_ancs (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (i j : Nat) :
    α.f j ∈ s'.ancs (α.f i) ↔ j ∈ s.ancs i := by
  rw [h.ancs hd hd', α.mem_map_f]

/-- Effective anchors correspond (§44; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.effAnchor (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (x : Nat) :
    s'.effAnchor (α.f x) = α.f (s.effAnchor x) := by
  unfold S3.effAnchor; rw [h.ancs hd hd', List.getLastD_map]

/-- Activity is invariant (§42, §44; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.active (h : SRel π α s s') (x : Nat) : s'.Active (α.f x) ↔ s.Active x := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y', hy', ha⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hr⟩ := h.A_some' hy'
    exact ⟨y, hy, by rw [← hr.active]; exact ha⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, ha⟩
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
    exact ⟨y', hy', by rw [hr.active]; exact ha⟩

/-- Anchor membership is invariant (§44: `D(p)` is a set; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.mem_D (h : SRel π α s s') (q x : Nat) : α.f x ∈ s'.D (π.f q) ↔ x ∈ s.D q :=
  (h.D q).mem_iff.trans (α.mem_map_f _ _)

/-- Footprint membership is invariant (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.mem_footprint (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (l q : Nat) :
    π.f l ∈ footprint s'.P (π.f q) ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P q :=
  mem_footprint_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 l q

/-- Footprints correspond up to permutation (§40, §42: a set; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.footprint_perm (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (q : Nat) :
    (footprint s'.P (π.f q)).Perm ((footprint s.P q).map π.f) :=
  footprint_perm_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 q

/-! ## Usability, frames of places, live holders (§40, §49.8) -/

/-- `Usable` is preserved forward (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.usable_of (h : SRel π α s s') {q : Nat} (hq : s.Usable q) : s'.Usable (π.f q) := by
  induction hq with
  | frame hpl hd ho hf =>
    rename_i f _
    exact .frame (f := f) (by rw [h.P.get, hpl]; rfl) (by rw [h.dead]; exact hd)
      (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren]) (by rw [h.F]; exact hf)
  | place hpl hd ho _ ih =>
    exact .place (by rw [h.P.get, hpl]; rfl) (by rw [h.dead]; exact hd)
      (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren]) ih

/-- `Usable` is invariant (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.usable (h : SRel π α s s') (q : Nat) : s'.Usable (π.f q) ↔ s.Usable q :=
  ⟨fun hq => by simpa only [Ren.symm_f, π.gf] using h.symm.usable_of hq, h.usable_of⟩

/-- Live holders are invariant (§49.8; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.holderLive (h : SRel π α s s') (o : Holder) :
    HolderLive s' (o.ren π) ↔ HolderLive s o := by
  cases o with
  | frame f => show f ∈ s'.F ↔ f ∈ s.F; rw [h.F]
  | place p => exact h.usable p

/-- `FrameOf` is preserved forward (§40, `placeFrame`; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.frameOf_of (h : SRel π α s s') {q f : Nat} (hq : FrameOf s q f) :
    FrameOf s' (π.f q) f := by
  induction hq with
  | frame hpl ho =>
    exact .frame (by rw [h.P.get, hpl]; rfl) (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren])
  | place hpl ho _ ih =>
    exact .place (by rw [h.P.get, hpl]; rfl) (by simp only [Place.ren, ho, Holder.ren]) ih

/-- `FrameOf` is invariant; frames are not renamed (§40, `placeFrame`; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.frameOf (h : SRel π α s s') (q f : Nat) : FrameOf s' (π.f q) f ↔ FrameOf s q f :=
  ⟨fun hq => by simpa only [Ren.symm_f, π.gf] using h.symm.frameOf_of hq, h.frameOf_of⟩

/-- `placeFrame` is invariant (§40; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.pframe (h : SRel π α s s') (q : Nat) : s'.pframe (π.f q) = s.pframe q :=
  Option.ext fun f => by rw [pframe_iff, pframe_iff, h.frameOf]

/-- The frame of a holder is invariant (§44; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.hframe (h : SRel π α s s') (o : Holder) : s'.hframe (o.ren π) = s.hframe o := by
  cases o with
  | frame f => rfl
  | place p => exact h.pframe p

/-! ## Effective modes (§43) -/

/-- Modes of covering active descendants are invariant as a set (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.mem_descModes (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (a p : Nat)
    (m : Mode) : m ∈ descModes s' (α.f a) (π.f p) ↔ m ∈ descModes s a p := by
  simp only [Access.mem_descModes]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, y', hy', h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
    rw [← α.fg j] at hy' h3
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyy⟩ := h.A_some' hy'
    refine ⟨α.g j, y, hy, hyy.active ▸ h1, (hyy.mem_footprint p).1 h2,
      (h.mem_ancs hd hd' _ _).1 h3, hyy.mode ▸ h4⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, y, hy, h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hyy⟩ := h.A_some hy
    exact ⟨α.f j, y', hy', hyy.active ▸ h1, (hyy.mem_footprint p).2 h2,
      (h.mem_ancs hd hd' _ _).2 h3, hyy.mode.symm ▸ h4⟩

/-- `effOf` reads its list of modes as a set (§43, cases 2–4). -/
theorem effOf_congr {m : Mode} {ds ds' : List Mode} (h : ∀ x, x ∈ ds ↔ x ∈ ds') :
    effOf m ds = effOf m ds' := by
  have h0 : ds = [] ↔ ds' = [] := by simp only [List.eq_nil_iff_forall_not_mem, h]
  simp only [effOf, h0, h Mode.modify]

/-- Effective modes are invariant (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.effective (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (a p : Nat) :
    effective s' (α.f a) (π.f p) = effective s a p := by
  cases hy : s.A[a]? with
  | none => simp only [Access.effective, hy, (h.A_none a).1 hy]
  | some y =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
    simp only [Access.effective, hy, hy', hr.active, hr.mem_footprint, hr.mode,
      effOf_congr (h.mem_descModes hd hd' a p)]

/-- Footprints of authorities correspond up to permutation (§42: a set; §49, last
paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.afp (h : SRel π α s s') (a : Nat) : (s'.afp (α.f a)).Perm ((s.afp a).map π.f) := by
  unfold S3.afp
  cases hy : s.A[a]? with
  | none => rw [(h.A_none a).1 hy]; exact .nil
  | some y =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
    rw [hy']; exact hr.footprint

/-- Footprint membership of authorities is invariant (§42; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.mem_afp (h : SRel π α s s') (a l : Nat) : π.f l ∈ s'.afp (α.f a) ↔ l ∈ s.afp a :=
  (h.afp a).mem_iff.trans (π.mem_map_f _ _)

/-- Sufficient effective mode over a footprint is invariant (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.forall_footprint_allows (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s')
    (q a : Nat) (m : Mode) :
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s'.P (π.f q), Allows (effective s' (α.f a) l) m) ↔
      ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P q, Allows (effective s a l) m :=
  π.forall_mem_iff (fun l => h.mem_footprint hd hd' l q)
    (fun l => by rw [h.effective hd hd'])

/-! ## Exercise and rights (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3) -/

/-- `ExercisableAt` is preserved forward (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.exercisableAt_of (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') {a : Nat}
    {m : Mode} (he : s.ExercisableAt a m) : s'.ExercisableAt (α.f a) m := by
  induction he with
  | base hy ha hm hf =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
    exact .base hy' (by rw [hr.active]; exact ha) (by rw [hr.mode]; exact hm)
      (by rw [hr.holder, hf, h.top]; rfl)
  | held hy ha hm hp _ hc ih =>
    obtain ⟨y', hy', hr⟩ := h.A_some hy
    exact .held hy' (by rw [hr.active]; exact ha) (by rw [hr.mode]; exact hm)
      (by rw [hr.holder, hp]; rfl) ih ((h.forall_footprint_allows hd hd' _ _ _).2 hc)

/-- `ExercisableAt` is invariant (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.exercisableAt (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (a : Nat)
    (m : Mode) : s'.ExercisableAt (α.f a) m ↔ s.ExercisableAt a m :=
  ⟨fun he => by simpa only [Ren.symm_f, α.gf] using h.symm.exercisableAt_of hd' hd he,
   h.exercisableAt_of hd hd'⟩

/-- `HasRight` is invariant (§43; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.hasRight (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (m : Mode) (q : Nat) :
    HasRight s' m (π.f q) ↔ HasRight s m q :=
  α.exists_mem_iff h.mem_rangeA fun a =>
    and_congr (h.exercisableAt hd hd' a m) (h.forall_footprint_allows hd hd' q a m)

/-- `Grounds` is invariant (§43; §63.4, §69.2, §70.3; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.grounds (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (m : Mode) (q g : Nat) :
    Grounds s' m (π.f q) (α.f g) ↔ Grounds s m q g :=
  and_congr (h.mem_rangeA g)
    (and_congr (h.exercisableAt hd hd' g m) (h.forall_footprint_allows hd hd' q g m))

/-- `RightChain` is invariant (§63.4, §69.2, §70.3; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.rightChain (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (g j : Nat) :
    RightChain s' (α.f g) (α.f j) ↔ RightChain s g j :=
  or_congr α.f_inj (h.mem_ancs hd hd' g j)

/-! ## Dependencies and anchor order (§44, §54) -/

/-- Anchors gathered over the places selected by corresponding predicates correspond up to
permutation (§44: `D(p)` is a set; §63, `ok` effect; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.filter_flatMap_D (h : SRel π α s s') {Q Q' : Nat → Bool}
    (hQ : ∀ r, Q' (π.f r) = Q r) :
    (((List.range s'.P.length).filter Q').flatMap s'.D).Perm
      ((((List.range s.P.length).filter Q).flatMap s.D).map α.f) := by
  have hL : ((List.range s'.P.length).filter Q').Perm
      (((List.range s.P.length).filter Q).map π.f) :=
    π.perm_of_mem (List.Pairwise.filter _ List.nodup_range)
      (List.Pairwise.filter _ List.nodup_range) fun r => by
        simp only [List.mem_filter, h.P.mem_range, hQ]
  refine (hL.flatMap_right s'.D).trans ?_
  rw [List.flatMap_map, List.map_flatMap]
  exact perm_flatMap_pointwise fun r _ => h.D r

/-- Inherited anchors correspond up to permutation (§44; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.depsOf (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (q : Nat) :
    (Access.depsOf s' (π.f q)).Perm ((Access.depsOf s q).map α.f) :=
  h.filter_flatMap_D fun r => decide_eq_decide.2 (partOf_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1 r q)

/-- `DepsValid` is invariant (§44; §66.3, §67.3, §68.3; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.depsValid (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (p : Nat) :
    DepsValid s' (π.f p) ↔ DepsValid s p :=
  π.forall_mem_iff h.P.mem_range fun q => by
    rw [partOf_ren h.P hd.1 hd'.1]
    exact imp_congr_right fun _ => α.forall_mem_iff (h.mem_D q) h.active

/-- `EffAnchorOK` is invariant; frames are not renamed (§44; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.effAnchorOK (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (x : Nat)
    (fd : Option Nat) : EffAnchorOK s' (α.f x) fd ↔ EffAnchorOK s x fd := by
  unfold EffAnchorOK
  rw [h.effAnchor hd hd']
  cases hz : s.A[s.effAnchor x]? with
  | none => rw [(h.A_none _).1 hz]
  | some z =>
    obtain ⟨z', hz', hr⟩ := h.A_some hz
    rw [hz']
    simp only [OptP, hr.holder, h.hframe, h.F]

/-- `AnchorOrder` is preserved forward (§44, §54; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.anchorOrder_of (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s')
    (ha : AnchorOrder s) : AnchorOrder s' := by
  intro q' hq' x' hx'
  rw [← π.fg q'] at hq' hx' ⊢
  rw [← α.fg x'] at hx' ⊢
  rw [h.pframe, h.effAnchorOK hd hd']
  exact ha _ ((h.usable _).1 hq') _ ((h.mem_D _ _).1 hx')

/-- `AnchorOrder` is invariant (§44, §54; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.anchorOrder (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') :
    AnchorOrder s' ↔ AnchorOrder s :=
  ⟨h.symm.anchorOrder_of hd' hd, h.anchorOrder_of hd hd'⟩

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` is preserved forward (§44, §54; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.anchorOrderHeld_of (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s')
    (ha : AnchorOrderHeld s) : AnchorOrderHeld s' := by
  intro q' hq' x' y' hy' ya hh
  rw [← π.fg q'] at hq' hh ⊢
  rw [← α.fg x'] at hy' ⊢
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hr⟩ := h.A_some' hy'
  rw [h.pframe, h.effAnchorOK hd hd']
  rw [hr.holder] at hh
  exact ha _ ((h.usable _).1 hq') _ y hy (by rw [← hr.active]; exact ya)
    ((Holder.ren_inj π (b := .place (π.g q'))).1 hh)

/-- `AnchorOrderHeld` is invariant (§44, §54; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.anchorOrderHeld (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') :
    AnchorOrderHeld s' ↔ AnchorOrderHeld s :=
  ⟨h.symm.anchorOrderHeld_of hd' hd, h.anchorOrderHeld_of hd hd'⟩

/-! ## Dynamic pinning, leaves of usable places (§74, §66.1) -/

/-- Dynamic pinning is invariant (§74; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.pin (h : SRel π α s s') (l : Nat) : s'.pin (π.f l) = s.pin l := by
  rw [Bool.eq_iff_iff, S3.pin_iff, S3.pin_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, ob', hob', ha, hl⟩
    obtain ⟨ob, hob, hr⟩ := h.pins_some' hob'
    exact ⟨i, ob, hob, by rw [← hr.active]; exact ha, (hr.mem_leaves l).1 hl⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, ob, hob, ha, hl⟩
    obtain ⟨ob', hob', hr⟩ := h.pins_some hob
    exact ⟨i, ob', hob', by rw [hr.active]; exact ha, (hr.mem_leaves l).2 hl⟩

/-- `LeafOfUsable` is invariant (§66.1, §67.1, §68.1; §49, last paragraph). -/
theorem SRel.leafOfUsable (h : SRel π α s s') (hd : Down s) (hd' : Down s') (l : Nat) :
    LeafOfUsable s' (π.f l) ↔ LeafOfUsable s l :=
  π.exists_mem_iff h.P.mem_range fun q => and_congr (h.usable q) (h.mem_footprint hd hd' l q)

end Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Rename
